---
title: "Typst marks no page prints"
description: 'Marks no page prints: [Halyard]{.index} [Hawser]{.index} [Bitt]{.index} [Horn]{.index entry="Cleat!Horn"} [Davit]{.index} [Fender]{.index} [Rope]{.index entry="Fender!Rope"} [Gaff]{.index} [Sheave]{.index} [oar]{.index entry="Oar" see="Paddle"} [Thole]{.index index="spare"} [Rig]{.index range="open"}.'
indexes:
  - name: main
    title: Index
  - name: spare
    title: Spare Index
filters:
  - index
---

The fixture for a mark no page prints in a Typst index (M117). Quarto's
Typst template does not print `description:`, so the label of each mark
written there names no element. An entry whose marks are all such marks,
with no cross-reference and no sub-entry that prints, is left out of the
index, and so is a letter group none of whose entries prints.

The description writes twelve marks. `Halyard` and `Hawser` are marked there
alone, and are the only terms of their letter, so the index prints neither
them nor an `H` heading. `Bitt` is also marked in the body, on page 2, so it
prints that page alone. `Cleat!Horn` is a sub-entry under a parent marked in
the body, so `Cleat` prints and `Horn` does not. `Davit`, `Fender`,
`Fender!Rope` and `Gaff` print with no page number, each above a sub-entry
that prints. `Rig` opens a range there that closes on page 2, so its closing
mark is on a page: `Rig` prints, with no page number.

Three marks there show what is still printed. `Oar` is a cross-reference
mark, which has no label, so `Oar, see Paddle` prints. `Sheave` is left out,
and `Block, see Sheave` still prints, with nothing reported. `Thole` is the
only mark of the second index, so that index prints its heading alone.

The body marks a parent that prints its page: [Cleat]{.index}, and the
target of a cross-reference: [Paddle]{.index}.

{{< pagebreak >}}

The body marks a term the description marks too: [Bitt]{.index}.

A sub-entry prints under a parent the description alone marks:
[arm]{.index entry="Davit!Arm"}.

A sub-entry two levels down prints under two such entries:
[eye]{.index entry="Fender!Rope!Eye"}.

A sub-entry with a cross-reference and no page prints under such a parent:
[jaw]{.index entry="Gaff!Jaw" see="Bitt"}.

A term with a cross-reference and no page prints:
[kedge]{.index entry="Kedge" see="Bitt"}.

A cross-reference to a term the index leaves out prints:
[block]{.index entry="Block" see="Sheave"}.

The range the description opens closes here: [Rig]{.index range="close"}.
